CONTRACT_CODES.doc: The refusals of the contract-directory reader and of the links check (docs/contract-dir.md), by the code a refusal is printed with. A code is never reworded. The reader's own table: not a declaration, so no render carries it and it is not installed in the contract directory.

dirAbsent.doc: no contract directory was found, or the one named does not exist

manifestAbsent.doc: a package directory holds no MANIFEST.json

manifestInvalid.doc: a manifest is not JSON, lacks a field, or names another package or schema major than its place

manifestMismatch.doc: a listed file is missing, a file is present but not listed, or its hash differs

schemaMajor.doc: a file's $schema is not the installed form of the reader's schema major

schemaTooOld.doc: a file's requires.omx-contract-schema floor is above the reader's schema

schemaFloorAbsent.doc: an installed file of a package other than omx-contract states no schema floor

fileInvalid.doc: a file breaks the schema or the kernel-file shape, an unknown key or word included

refUndeclared.doc: a reference names an item of a package the file does not require

packageAbsent.doc: a package the consumer or a file requires is not installed

packageTooOld.doc: a required package is installed below its floor

sourceAbsent.doc: a link's path does not exist

sourceSymbolAbsent.doc: the path holds no definition of the link's symbol

sourceAmbiguous.doc: the path defines the link's symbol more than once

sourceDiffers.doc: the value at a from link is not the declared value

sourceUnevaluable.doc: a from link whose value the tool cannot read

sourceUnread.doc: an impl link whose definition does not name the item

sourceNone.doc: an item with no impl link, where every item must carry one
